metrics.aligned_far_only: canonical echo/output mean-square ratio in 19 fixed blocks of 1600 samples, retaining all block values and nulls
metrics.canonical_si_sdr: speech_spatial.si_sdr_span (run_validation_engine), same normalized sample units and unchanged 1e-12 floor
metrics.comparison: force-linear final versus observe final, each with exact fixed 128-sample delay; linear is a required unchanged upstream witness.
metrics.endpoint_events: Retain all S16 endpoint and energy changes as outcomes; do not discard unfavorable cases or call counts proven internal clipping events.
metrics.normalized_mse: sum((target-output)^2) / sum(target^2), same fixed target/output windows and declared delays; no gain fitting; null if target energy <= canonical epsilon
metrics.raw_amplitude: peak, RMS, exact endpoint count and finite range; endpoint counts describe exported saturation endpoints, not proven clipping events

identifiability.not_identifiable_if: Either view has projected_target_energy <= 1e-12 or nonfinite, or required canonical SI-SDR/NMSE is null
identifiability.projected_target_energy: Using the same fixed windows, normalized samples and summation order as canonical SI-SDR: alpha=sum(target*output)/sum(target^2); projected_target_energy=sum((alpha*target)^2)
identifiability.reason: The unchanged canonical epsilon formula returns a finite 0 dB for an all-zero estimate; that numerical result does not establish target information retention.

rule.INCONCLUSIVE_MIXED_INDICATORS: Finite identifiable indicators disagree in direction.
rule.NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: Either final view lacks finite canonical SI-SDR/NMSE or projected_target_energy <= 1e-12.
rule.NOT_SUPPORTED_IN_DISCLOSED_WINDOW: Candidate-minus-observe SI-SDR <= 0 AND candidate normalized MSE >= observe normalized MSE.
rule.NO_SELECTOR_Y_EXPOSURE_IN_PRIMARY_SUPPOR: Every observed source_linear is true for block indices 1525..1975 inclusive; stop without candidate execution.
rule.SUPPORTED_IN_DISCLOSED_WINDOW: Candidate-minus-observe SI-SDR > 0 AND candidate normalized MSE < observe normalized MSE; descriptive conditional causal support only.

source_anchors.basis: Empty initial buffer; each 80-sample subframe contributes contiguous capture samples to 64-sample blocks.
Initial 64 zeros; sample stream is delayed 64 samples independently of 80-sample emission chunks.
Two 80-sample capture subframes per 160-sample API frame; flush exactly one remaining 64-sample block when available.
Reverse-before-capture starts render before capture; default internal delay estimator calls EchoRemover on every processed capture block.
counter starts at 0 and increments once per ProcessCapture; e_old/y_old hold prior raw block; only local Y_fft selector may be intervened.
z_k is IFFT_k first half plus IFFT_(k-1) second half; previous half is overwritten completely once per processed block.
UseLinearFilterOutput and UsableLinearEstimate both depend on the same filter-quality state; neither method is changed.
Selector is adaptive-state dependent; no inference of its runtime value from elapsed time or F07 scores is allowed.
Default fixed_capture_delay_samples=0 and use_external_delay_estimator=false. Only a separately named research config struct may be added.
Config copy/assignment and validation must preserve the separately added research fields; this file remains unmodified.

timing_contract.fft_at_block_k: sqrt-Hann-windowed [raw block k-1, raw block k], with zero old block at startup
timing_contract.proof_scope: This is exact support for the local synthesis E/Y selector, not a reconstruction of all adaptive-filter or gain history.
timing_contract.support_reason: Every target block q uses synthesis output z_(q+1), which depends on selector at q and q+1; include the first OLA predecessor and the final current synthesis block.
timing_contract.synthesis_z_k: IFFT_(k-1)[64:128] times synthesis window second half plus IFFT_k[0:64] times first half; full old half overwritten each block
timing_contract.unexpected_count_or_delay_policy: Stop method, preserve outputs, do not reindex or fit delay to speech.

trace.bit_conversion: memcpy binary32 float to uint32, no aliasing cast, rounding, text-float conversion or numerical perturbation; require IEC559 binary32.
trace.capture_output_unused_policy: Never read uninitialized gain locals. A missing gain observation, null payload, missing trace, or capture_output_used=false causes scientific method rejection; preserve the raw failure.
trace.counter_basis: Existing block_counter_ starts at 0 and increments at EchoRemoverImpl::ProcessCapture entry; expose block_counter_-1; no new DSP counter or reset.
trace.dominant_nearend_after_gain_timing: This is the current block state after GetGain. ResidualEchoEstimator::Estimate in the same block already consumed the earlier, pre-GetGain state; the two meanings must not be conflated.
force_linear_invariants: source_linear sequence exactly equals observe at all 4000 blocks
gain_bits exactly equal observe at every block
high_bands_gain_bits exactly equal observe at every block
dominant_nearend_after_gain exactly equal observe at every block
trace.forced_meaning: An actual default-Y to applied-E substitution at this block, not merely force-linear mode enabled.
trace.gain_validation: Decode recorded bits and require finite G[0..64] and high_bands_gain in [0,1]. Do not replace, clip or normalize values.
trace.observation_location: After suppression_gain_.GetGain and before suppression_filter_.ApplyGain, with source_linear captured from the original local selector after aec_state_.Update.
trace.parse_policy: Reject duplicate JSON keys, unknown fields, wrong types, malformed intended trace lines, missing/duplicate/out-of-order indices, reset/multiple instances, nonfinite numbers, false capture_output_used, and any row count mismatch. Preserve all raw stderr bytes.
trace.secondary_observation_role: Exact conditional-arm identity witnesses and retained material for a later separately registered hypothesis. No additional primary, parameter selection, automatic causal attribution, or change to the E/Y exposure gate.
